events.detail: Observed a setup guide draft claiming native hook parity for Codex and OpenCode without adapter evidence.
Retrieved platforms/platforms.yaml, compatibility/matrix.json, mcps/generated/ bundles, and the harness-audit detection results.
Proposed two candidates: 'adapter-matrix-backed-drift-check' (matrix-backed recommendation) and 'unsupported-hook-parity-claim' (parity claim without evidence).
Verifier checked adapter state, install/onramp path, verification command, and config-preservation behavior; the parity claim failed native support checks.
Promoted 'adapter-matrix-backed-drift-check'; publication of packages or plugins stays blocked.
